summary: Omit color stages above the highest live color using existing completed capacity-gate feedback, avoiding zero-work Metal encoding overhead.
regressions: CPU and Metal frame tests skip and reenable a stage as its gate count changes; validators reject unknown, zero, missing and not-yet-completed conditions.
Six-frame Balls replay compares exact poses, velocities, pair membership, active links, active cached states and active tile fields against the saved original schedule.
differences: Conditions only apply after all gates. The highest-color counter was already read for palette overflow; no new readback or synchronization point is added. Standalone programs safely retain all launches.
